heard: The largest structure ever built in space is being destroyed. The International Space Station spans 109 meters, rivaling a football field. Inside its pressurized volume matches a Boeing 747 airliner. Fifteen nations partner together to assemble it piece by piece. Humans have lived aboard the station continuously since November 2000. It orbits 250 miles high, circling Earth every 90 minutes. Yet NASA plans to end operations around 2030. A dedicated deorbit craft will steer the massive complex into the ocean. No human construction in orbit has ever matched it.
